The 5 new large flow trades likely represent institutional positioning ahead of a potential breakout, creating the model disagreement between short-term bullish momentum (7d/14d models) and longer-term bearish structure (21d champion model). The CAG reading of 0.94 indicates extreme bullish sentiment that historically precedes corrections. This setup suggests we're in the late stages of a gamma-supported rally that's masking underlying bearish pressure.
